annotations.title: Start a comment thread on an Artifact

description: Leave a new comment thread on one of your Artifacts, as the agent. Without an anchor the thread is a general comment on the page. The thread is activated from the start, so you can reply to it and resolve it later. Mention a person with @[Name](mention:uid) using ids from the Artifact's mentionables.

anchor.description: Optional pin. { kind: "page", slideId, slideIndex, timeSec } for a slide or time; { kind: "element", selector, xFrac, yFrac, snapshot: { tag, text }, slideId, slideIndex, cueTarget, timeSec } for an element; { kind: "text", quote, prefix, suffix, selector, slideId, slideIndex } for a passage.

body.description: Markdown subset: bold, italic, code, links, lists.

name: create_artifact_thread

agent_activated.description: True once someone mentioned the agent; only then may the agent reply or resolve.

anchor.description: Where the thread is pinned: kind element (selector, snapshot, slide), text (quote), or page.

created_by.description: Who wrote it: { kind: "user", uid, name, handle, avatarUrl } or { kind: "agent", principal, name, via }.

author.description: Who wrote it: { kind: "user", uid, name, handle, avatarUrl } or { kind: "agent", principal, name, via }.
